environment.description: Ktor microservice running on ECS Fargate in a private subnet. The task role (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/upload-service-role) has s3:PutObject permission on arn:aws:s3:::user-uploads-prod/*. The VPC has a gateway endpoint for S3 (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f) with a default policy (Allow * on *). The S3 bucket has no bucket policy restrictions beyond the IAM role permissions. No WAF or API Gateway in front of the service - direct ALB to ECS routing.
